channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Amazon asks sellers in US to pay up for faster delivery as it expands sub-same day service
item.description: Amazon is asking some third-party sellers using its fulfilment service to to bid for access to faster delivery, expanding its sub-Same Day programme while giving sellers a chance to boost sales.

item.title: Nepal resumes flood rescue as thousands remain missing, finance minister seeks $4-5 billion for rebuilding
item.description: Nepal has resumed flood rescue operations after weather forced a brief pause, as authorities search for thousands missing and seek specialist foreign assistance and billions of dollars to rebuild.

item.title: From 'taking advantage' to 'can retaliate': Five issues driving the US-Canada trade war
item.description: The US-Canada trade war is rooted in five key differences: Washington says Canada exploits the US, while Ottawa cites sovereignty; both clash over tariffs, concessions, leverage and deep economic ties, as Canada seeks to reduce its dependence on America.

item.title: Are Chinese bots influencing US citizens? X flags suspected bot campaign over AI data centre, energy policy
item.description: X says around 200 accounts linked to a suspected Chinese bot farm tried to influence Americans' views on AI data centres and energy policy. The posts targeted concerns over electricity demand and utility costs, amid growing US opposition to data centre expansion.

item.title: Trump speech bets land ex-White House teleprompter operator in trouble, fined ₹1.65 crore: What CFTC found
item.description: A White House teleprompter operator, Gabriel Perez, will pay over $172,000 or nearly ₹1.65 crore to settle a federal investigation into prediction-market bets linked to Trump’s speeches. He faces a $65,000 penalty and forfeit of $107,000 in profits.

item.title: ‘100% false’: Pete Hegseth shuts down reports of 2028 presidential run
item.description: US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth has dismissed reports that he is considering a 2028 presidential bid. In a latest post on X, he called the speculation false and said that his focus remains on his current role.

item.title: Nepal floods: 88 Indians rescued, 287 still missing; India sends forensic, tunnel teams — Latest updates
item.description: Nepal floods: Four Indian nationals were rescued from a hydropower project in Rasuwa district. The Ministry of External Affairs reported 88 Indians have been rescued, with 287 still missing. Forensic teams and a specialized tunnel rescue team from India are assisting in ongoing relief efforts.

item.title: Everest hing ban: FSSAI cites 'excessive starch, low alcohol soluble extract' in compounded asafetida
item.description: FSSAI has banned the sale of compounded hing made by Everest and LG after tests found low alcohol-soluble extract and excessive starch content. The regulator said the products failed prescribed food safety standards and advised a voluntary recall.

item.title: CNG price hike in Delhi: Autorickshaw unions demand higher fare rate, threaten strike if demands unmet
item.description: CNG price hike in Delhi: On Saturday, CNG price saw a hike of ₹3.89 due to the ongoing tensions between Iran and the US, said BJP national spokesperson Syed Shahnawaz Hussain. He added that the price will come down post the geopolitical tensions.

item.title: ‘Do you feel you are lord?’ Bombay HC pulls up FDA; agency revokes suspension of licences of 5 MCA restaurants
item.description: The report showed that the five eateries, located in the Bandra-Kurla Complex area, were 88% compliant with food safety requirements.

item.title: FSSAI's 'red coloured hexagon' plan: Which packaged foods could soon carry the warning?
item.description: Under the proposed system, a red-coloured hexagonal warning would appear on the front of food packages when a product contains high levels of at least two of the specified nutrients.

item.title: Mamata Banerjee in legal trouble as Kolkata Police file suo moto FIR against former West Bengal CM — here's why
item.description: Kolkata Police filed a suo motu FIR against Mamata Banerjee for allegedly violating Calcutta High Court conditions during a TMCP foundation day event. The FIR was registered at Hastings Police Station, and an investigation will examine the involvement of all parties in the violation.

item.title: E20 row: Supreme Court to hear plea seeking ethanol labels at petrol pumps on Aug 31
item.description: The petitioner has further asked authorities to create a publicly accessible database detailing vehicle compatibility with different ethanol blends.

item.title: Tourist accidentally films Nepal glacier collapse linked to Gyirong Port mudslide; China expert confirms location: Video
item.description: A glacier collapse in Nepal caused a devastating torrent of rocks and debris, resulting in the deaths of 626 people in Nepal and seven in Tibet. A tourist in China captured the moment of the collapse, which was confirmed by a local scientist.

item.title: Explained | Why Bengaluru civic body fined 10 food outlets, including McDonald's, KFC; list of other outlets under lens
item.description: The establishments were handed fines ranging between ₹5,000 and ₹25,000, depending on the violations detected during the inspection.

item.title: FM Sitharaman promotes made-in-India potential for the 'world'; highlights Aadhaar, UPI, DigiLocker, ONDC initiatives
item.description: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman addressed investors in Chicago, promoting India's manufacturing potential for global markets. She emphasized digital infrastructure's role and urged international partners to view India as a hub for innovation.

item.title: Vietnam Restates Readiness for ‘Constructive’ US Trade Talks
item.description: Vietnam’s Deputy Prime Minister Nguyen Van Thang, looking to reinvigorate months-long negotiations over a final tariff deal with the Trump administration, reiterated to US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer the Southeast Asian country’s readiness for “open, constructive” trade talks.

item.title: Nepal floods: 3 days roll on with no trace of 77 Isha Foundation missing pilgrims | ‘Rescue teams are on ground but….'
item.description: A total of 77 Isha Foundation pilgrims remain missing after flash floods hit the Nepal-Tibet border. Efforts by the organization to locate them have been unsuccessful. The group with participants from 19 nationalities was returning from a pilgrimage.&nbsp;

item.title: ₹5.93 lakh, 13 days in New Zealand: Couple's honeymoon stuns internet; 'We didn't try to make trip budget-friendly…'
item.description: They travelled across both New Zealand's North and South Islands, stayed in private Airbnbs and used rental cars, while still making room for several major tourist experiences.

item.title: India-Central Asia ties in focus as PM Modi begins Uzbekistan and Kyrgyzstan visit
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi embarked on a two-nation visit to Uzbekistan and Kyrgyzstan on Saturday. He will hold bilateral talks in Tashkent and attend the 26th SCO Summit in Bishkek, aiming to strengthen India's strategic partnerships, trade, and regional security across Central Asia.

item.title: World News Today highlights on August 29, 2026 : Tourist accidentally films Nepal glacier collapse linked to Gyirong Port mudslide; China expert confirms location: Video
item.description: World News Today highlights on August 29, 2026: Stay informed on global events with our in-depth world news coverage, bringing you the latest developments across politics, economy, and culture. Discover insights into international affairs, breaking news, and the trends shaping our interconnected world, all in one place.

item.title: Nepal flood death toll at 616: ‘At least $4 bn’ needed for rebuilding; minister denies refusing foreign help — 5 points
item.description: Nepal needs $4 billion to $5 billion for rebuilding after the devastating flood that struck its border areas this week, Finance Minister Swarnim Wagle told Reuters on Saturday.

item.title: UGC-NET June 2026: Results for 84 subjects out; re-exam dates for English, Commerce, and Sociology released — Details
item.description: The National Testing Agency (NTA) had ordered fresh examinations for candidates who appeared for the English, Commerce and Sociology papers in June this year after an expert committee found factual, typographical, translation and language-related errors in the question papers.

item.title: 24 salary receipts a year better than 12? Indian expat in Australia explains benefits of fortnightly paychecks
item.description: An Indian expat in Australia advocated for fortnightly salaries, sharing how this payment cycle improves his financial management. He argued that receiving pay every two weeks allows better budgeting, savings, and investment.

item.title: US to get new NASA-led space academy, Trump signs order: What is it all about? Explained
item.description: The US Space Academy is a proposed NASA-led federal academy dedicated to combining rigorous technical education with leadership development, discipline, and a durable commitment to public service.

item.title: Nearly 2,500 Missing as Nepal, China Intensify Rescue Efforts
item.description: Nearly 2,500 people are missing following the flash floods that devastated a mountainous region between Nepal and China, with authorities on both sides of the border stepping up rescue efforts.

item.title: Bad news for CNG users in Delhi! Price hiked by ₹3.89 per kg: Check new rate here; know what led to the increase
item.description: Indraprastha Gas Limited (IGL) has announced a hike in CNG prices in Delhi. Check new rates here.

item.title: Of advisor bots and fee cuts in the times of exec coaching wars
item.description: India's booming executive coaching industry is turning into a price war. New entrants are undercutting veterans to build hours and credentials, corporate clients are pushing for discounts, and AI looms as a cheaper alternative.

item.title: The week in charts: A decade of UPI, services inflation, Kanda Express
item.description: In this weekly Plain Facts compilation, we present to you data-based insights, with easy-to-read charts, to help you delve deeper into the stories reported by Mint in the week gone by.

item.title: Trump announces ‘biggest oil deal in history’ giving US majority control of 65 billion barrels of Venezuelan reserves
item.description: Donald Trump announced that the US has secured majority control of more than 65 billion barrels of Venezuela’s proven oil reserves in what he calls the ‘biggest oil deal in history.’ He says the agreement will double US reserves, lower domestic gas prices, and boost Venezuela’s economy.

item.title: Iran war news LIVE: IRGC navy claims ‘decisive control’ over Hormuz; Trump announces ‘biggest oil deal in world history’
item.description: Iran war news LIVE: Iran’s IRGC reportedly rejected the US’s repeated claims that the Strait of Hormuz is open, saying US officials are continuing to “lie” about the status of the waterway to influence the price of oil and “cover up their failures.”

item.title: Apple TV hikes prices in US as streaming service gets more expensive
item.description: Apple is raising the price of its Apple TV streaming service in the US, with monthly and annual plans becoming more expensive immediately. The increase marks the fourth price hike since the service launched in 2019.

item.title: Dolly Parton airport? Tennessee governor backs fans’ push to rename Nashville airport after country music icon
item.description: A campaign to rename Nashville International Airport after Dolly Parton has gained support from Tennessee Governor Bill Lee and the airport authority's CEO, just days after the country music icon's death at 80.&nbsp;

item.title: Trump administration targets Egyptian bank’s UAE branches in fresh push to isolate Iran
item.description: The Trump administration has moved to restrict Banque Misr's UAE branches from the US financial system. They have accused the bank of supporting Iran, as Washington intensifies its push to economically isolate Tehran and pressure countries to cut financial ties.&nbsp;

item.title: Big change for packaged foods? India proposes front-pack warnings for high sugar, salt and fat, says report
item.description: The FSSAI proposed a red hexagonal label for foods high in saturated fat, sugar, and salt to promote consumer awareness. Despite government efforts, companies resisted warning labels, leading to public outcry for clearer food labeling in India.
